seo.meta_title: First Watch Hours: When It Opens, Closes & Holiday Hours
seo.meta_description: First Watch is open 7 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. daily and closed Thanksgiving and Christmas. Why it closes early, and how the online waitlist works.
seo.h1: First Watch Hours and Waitlist, Explained

question: What Are First Watch's Hours?
quick_answer: First Watch is open from 7 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. every day. It serves breakfast, brunch and lunch only, so it does not open for dinner. First Watch closes on Thanksgiving and Christmas Day. It doesn't take traditional reservations, but you can check wait times and join the waitlist through its app or website before you arrive.
key_facts: Breakfast, brunch and lunch only; no dinner
Join the waitlist in the app or on the website

body.heading: Daily hours
body.text: First Watch restaurants are open from 7 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. seven days a week, including weekends. The whole menu, from pancakes and omelets to lunch salads and sandwiches, is served during those hours, so you can order breakfast right up until closing. Hours can differ at a few locations, so check your local restaurant's page before going late in the day.

body.heading: Why First Watch closes at 2:30
body.text: First Watch is a daytime-only cafe built around breakfast, brunch and lunch. It does not serve dinner at all, which is why the restaurants close in the early afternoon. Many locations also serve brunch cocktails, but alcohol is not offered everywhere.

body.heading: Holiday hours
body.text: First Watch says it is closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas Day. On other holidays, most locations keep their normal 7 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. hours, but it's worth checking your local restaurant's page or the app for any changes.

body.heading: Does First Watch take reservations?
body.text: Not in the traditional sense. Instead, most First Watch restaurants let you check wait times and add your name to the waitlist before you arrive, through the First Watch app or the company's website. You can join as a guest, but logging in to an account lets you see your exact place in line. Weekend mornings are the busiest, so joining the waitlist early helps.

body.heading: Ordering ahead
body.text: If you'd rather skip the wait entirely, First Watch offers online ordering for pickup at most locations, and some offer delivery. For menu prices, see our First Watch menu page.
